map.权重合计不是 100% 会怎样？: What If the Weights Do Not Total 100%?
map.工具会自动归一化：实际权重 = 你填的权重 / 四项之和，因此无需手动凑 100: The tool normalizes automatically: actual weight = your weight ÷ the sum of the four, so you never need to force the total to 100%. The page shows the weight total and whether it equals 100% for easy checking; if you do not fill it up it still scales by proportion (all zeros falls back to equal weights).
map.四个维度评分怎么来？: Where Do the Four Dimension Scores Come From?
map.质量/价格/交期/服务各为 0–100 的归一化得分，可由企业考评细则映射（如合: Quality / price / delivery / service are each normalized scores from 0 to 100 and can be mapped from your own appraisal rules (for example pass rate to quality, quote competitiveness to price, on-time rate to delivery, responsiveness and after-sales to service). Be sure to use scores on the same scale, otherwise the dimensions are not comparable.
